# routeros_ip_proxy_direct (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ip_proxy_direct" "direct" {
  action   = "allow"
  comment  = "Managed by OpenTofu"
  disabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `action` (String) Whether the matched request is resolved directly or through the parent proxy. Unlike the access list, a request that matches no rule is passed to the parent proxy.
  * allow - contact the destination server directly.
  * deny - use the parent proxy.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `dst_address` (String) Matches the IP address of the destination (server) the request is sent to.
- `dst_host` (String) Matches the destination host name or IP address exactly as it was typed by the user. Wildcards `*` and `?` are supported; a value starting with a colon is treated as a regular expression.
- `dst_port` (String) Matches a destination port, a list of ports or port ranges.
- `local_port` (String) Matches the proxy port the request was received on.
- `method` (String) Matches the HTTP method of the request. RouterOS stores and reports the method in upper case, so the value has to be written in upper case to avoid a permanent difference.
- `path` (String) Matches the path of the resource requested from the server. Wildcards `*` and `?` are supported; a value starting with a colon is treated as a regular expression.
- `place_before` (String) Before which position the rule will be inserted.  
	> Please check the effect of this option, as it does not work as you think!  
	> Best way to use in conjunction with a data source. See [example](../data-sources/ip_firewall.md#example-usage).
- `src_address` (String) Matches the IP address of the client that originated the request.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ip/proxy/direct get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ip_proxy_direct.direct "*1"
```
